bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to environment; prohibiting the commissioner from adopting rules that apply only to construction and demolition landfills; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 115A.06, subdivision 2.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 115A.06, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Rules.
[+(a) +]Unless otherwise provided, the commissioner shall promulgate rules in accordance with chapter 14 to govern the agency's activities and implement this chapter.

[+(b) Notwithstanding paragraph (a) or any other provision of law, the commissioner must not adopt any rules that exclusively govern solid waste disposal facilities that accept only: +]

[+(1) construction and demolition debris and incidental nonrecyclable packaging; or +]

[+(2) industrial waste that is limited to wood, concrete, porcelain fixtures, shingles, or window glass resulting from the manufacture of construction materials. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to any proposed or adopted rule not yet effective on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; prohibiting the commissioner from adopting rules that apply only to construction and demolition landfills; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 115A.06, subdivision 2.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 115A.06, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Rules.
(a) Unless otherwise provided, the commissioner shall promulgate rules in accordance with chapter 14 to govern the agency's activities and implement this chapter.

(b) Notwithstanding paragraph (a) or any other provision of law, the commissioner must not adopt any rules that exclusively govern solid waste disposal facilities that accept only:

(1) construction and demolition debris and incidental nonrecyclable packaging; or

(2) industrial waste that is limited to wood, concrete, porcelain fixtures, shingles, or window glass resulting from the manufacture of construction materials.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to any proposed or adopted rule not yet effective on or after that date.
additions: (b) Notwithstanding paragraph (a) or any other provision of law, the commissioner must not adopt any rules that exclusively govern solid waste disposal facilities that accept only:
(1) construction and demolition debris and incidental nonrecyclable packaging; or
(2) industrial waste that is limited to wood, concrete, porcelain fixtures, shingles, or window glass resulting from the manufacture of construction materials.
This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to any proposed or adopted rule not yet effective on or after that date.
